Notes
Barista. 

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make your store the very best. 

Who you are?   We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and team player, who can strike up a good conversation. 

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, there are opportunities for development and progression within your store or one of our other stores on the Island, daily working hours (no late evenings), free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday, and recognition awards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

Barista. 

At Costa Coffee, we are what we craft. It's about perfecting latte art, creating experiences that put a smile on people's faces, and proudly making greatness every day. 

We’re passionate about being a great place to work, where you can bring your real self into our mix.    Making our drinks with heart, giving our customers a warm welcome and a lasting impression so they come back to our stores and enjoy an exceptional experience. 

What you’ll do.  Being a Barista means so much more than making velvety cups of joy. It’s your chance to learn, challenge yourself and truly master your craft - which means you’ll be: Putting smiles on faces come rain or shine; Mastering our menu, from toasties to seasonal drinks and more; Pouring passion into perfect drinks and great customer service; Keeping your store clean, tidy and welcoming; Working with your colleagues to make your store the very best. 

Who you are?   We’re interested in your unique ingredients:  A multi-tasker with a can-do attitude; not afraid to take on a challenge; A perfectionist, dedicated to delivering excellence; A people person and team player, who can strike up a good conversation. 

What we can offer: We’re really proud of the work our team members deliver, and we want you to feel valued and rewarded.   Our starting rate is £12.86 p/h, there are opportunities for development and progression within your store or one of our other stores on the Island, daily working hours (no late evenings), free hot and cold drinks on shift, plus discount on food and bottled drinks. 20 days paid holiday, and recognition awards. 

Please email your CV and covering letter outlining why you wish to become part of the Costa Team to 
hrteam@fancyacoffee.im

The Boatyard Restaurant is looking for a confident, experienced Restaurant Manager to join our leadership team and help drive the next chapter of our award winning coastal dining experience. Rooted in Manx provenance, warm hospitality, and a commitment to quality, The Boatyard is a busy, well loved restaurant where service, teamwork, and genuine care for our guests sit at the heart of everything we do.

As Restaurant Manager, you will take ownership of front of house operations, lead and develop a motivated team, and ensure every service runs with calm professionalism and attention to detail. You’ll work closely with the owner and kitchen leadership to uphold our standards, support menu launches, manage reservations and guest flow, oversee stock and financial controls, and contribute to the ongoing growth of the business.

We’re looking for someone who brings proven management experience in a quality led hospitality environment, a natural ability to lead, coach, and inspire a team, strong organisational and communication skills, a guest focused mindset with a passion for creating memorable experiences, confidence in rota planning, stock control, and operational systems

This is a full time role within a respected local brand, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and grow with a business that values professionalism, warmth, and community.

To apply, please send your CV and a short cover note to info@tartangroup.co.uk

Notes
Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.

We are looking for a cook / server to join our small team who has a cheerful and welcoming personality. We start early and finish early which is great, as you have the rest of the day to yourself. The job would be ideal for someone who is a good home cook, loves cooking, helping customers and enjoys variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

Your role will be to prepare a variety of daily foods in our kitchen in the mornings, under the guidance of our head chef, serve our lovely customers with their lunches at lunchtime and clearing after service. Home Made Cake baking experience will be particulary welcomed. Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 6.30 / 7.00 am to 3.00 pm (Mon – Fri), approx. 38 hours p.w. This is a Monday – Friday permanent day time role (i.e. non-seasonal).

An excellent standard and understanding of verbal and written English is required to enable instructions from customers to be completed accurately. 

We would welcome applications from experienced individuals, however we can also train you in any areas required. Barista experience, telephone experience and a full driving licence would be welcomed. 

Our business is geared to the corporate market and therefore our food must always go out on time, which means we need 100% reliability with your time keeping and attendance. You’ll be bright, smart, professional and clean in your appearance.  Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please either e-mail your CV to tastebuds@manx.net, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form. If you would like to know more about the role, please telephone Andrew on 615516 after 2.00 pm. If you have not heard from us within 14 days, please assume your application has not been successful.

Our client seeks a Business Service Operations Engineer to join their team. Role Profile: As a Business Service Operations Engineer, you will be an integral part of the frontline support team for our business customers, with your primary focus on service delivery and coordination. This office-based role provides a seamless and professional service that ensures customer requests and issues are resolved efficiently and to the highest standard. In this Service support role, you will handle a diverse range of service delivery responsibilities, including managing customer service requests, overseeing the provisioning, maintenance, and cancellation of enterprise business services, coordinating the delivery of business customer order requests, and taking receipt of deliveries. You will be the central point of contact for business customers, managing their service lifecycle from initial request through to completion. The role demands a strong sense of ownership and accountability for the service delivery process. Where customer issues arise that require technical resolution, your knowledge of products and services will enable you to support and assist technical teams in resolving problems efficiently. It is desirable that when escalation to specialist engineering teams is necessary, you are expected to review the resolution process and include your knowledge to the documented solutions to build product knowledge for future reference. For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16521

Our client seeks a Junior Credit Underwriter to support their Structured Finance Credit Team by assessing and analysing key financial and credit information and making recommendations for lending within the credit appetite and policy. Working within a supportive team environment, you'll gain exposure to sophisticated credit assessment processes while developing your expertise in this specialist area of finance. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with early credit or financial services experience who is eager to build deep technical underwriting expertise, develop strong analytical skills, and grow within a specialist structured finance environment. Evaluate customer credit data and financial statements to determine lending risk levels. Analyse audited accounts, management information, forecast cashflow, and budget planners. Complete annual credit reviews of structured finance customers and recommend appropriate covenants and security structures. Assess and approve credit proposals within delegated authority limits. Analyse affordability measures, financial crime risks, and fraudulent applications. Key Skills & Experience: Experience within a similar role in banking or asset finance industries. Strong knowledge of financial statements, ratios, and lending concepts. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with ability to influence at all levels. Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills. Proficiency in MS Office applications. Professional, detailed, and conscientious approach to work. Knowledge of block discounting, receivables assignment, and structured finance products (desirable but not essential). This is your chance to join a prestigious organisation that will invest in your professional development and provide a clear pathway to senior underwriting expertise.

Our client seeks a Claims Handler to join their team. You will play a key role in supporting the effective management of crew-related claims for yacht-owning clients. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organisational and communication skills and the ability to manage claims efficiently while maintaining accurate records and building effective relationships with stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Processing of claims, predominantly crew claims (personal injuries, illnesses) from yacht owning clients. Liaising with crew, insurers and involved experts to ensure full end-to-end claims management. Settlement of recoveries under the insurance contracts. Supervision and monitoring of claims records, ensuring timely claim resolution. Issuance and maintenance of claims management information for agreed stakeholders. Key Skills & Experience: Previous experience as an insurance claims handler would be desirable. Excellent organisational skills with ability to manage time effectively and meet deadlines. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Professional and approachable manner when interacting with colleagues and stakeholders. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written. Strong sense of discretion and confidentiality with understanding of handling sensitive information. Competent in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams and PowerPoint. Ideally completed a degree in marine insurance and/or yacht or ship management. This role is an excellent opportunity to join a respected organisation and develop your career in marine insurance and yacht management. If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding role where your skills will be valued and developed, we'd love to hear from you. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16401

Notes
We’re looking for a proactive and digitally-minded Marketing Manager to join the team at plan.com on a 12-month fixed term basis, supporting the delivery of multi-channel B2B marketing activity across both direct and partner channels. 
Working closely with marketing, sales, product and external partners, you’ll help co-ordinate campaigns, launches, customer communications and digital activity across channels including email, LinkedIn, Meta, webinars and web. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to fast-moving projects, collaborating across teams and helping turn ideas into well-executed marketing activity. 
No two days will look the same. Priorities shift quickly, projects move at pace, and you’ll be expected to adapt confidently while keeping activity organised and on track. We’re looking for someone who is naturally proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of tasks from briefing through to delivery. 
This role would suit someone with experience in a B2B, SaaS, telecoms or technology environment who enjoys both creative and operational aspects of marketing and wants to be closely involved in launches, campaigns and commercial marketing activity. 

Main Duties and Responsibilities: 

Marketing Campaigns & Launch Support: 
Support the delivery of multi-channel marketing campaigns across email, web, social and partner activity.  
Assist with launch planning and go-to-market co-ordination for new products, platform updates and campaigns.  
Help co-ordinate customer and partner communications across direct and channel audiences.  
Support the scheduling, setup and follow-up of webinars, campaigns and marketing activity.  
Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure campaigns and deliverables remain on track.  
Assist with campaign reporting, tracking and marketing performance updates where required.  
Collaborate with the wider marketing team, to co-ordinate campaign activity and deliverables. 

Digital Marketing & Content Co-ordination:
Assist with the management and scheduling of marketing content across digital channels.  
Support CRM and customer communication activity, including email campaigns and contact management. 
Help maintain brand and messaging consistency across marketing assets and communications.  
Support website and landing page updates where required.  
Assist with briefing and co-ordinating external agencies, designers and suppliers.  
Support the creation and co-ordination of marketing materials including presentations, sales collateral, webinar assets and customer communications. 
 
Project Management & Marketing Operations. 
Maintain project planners, trackers and shared marketing resources.  
Keep launch plans, timelines and action lists up to date.
Co-ordinate meetings, follow-ups and stakeholder communication across projects.  
Support the organisation of marketing documentation, shared assets and internal processes.
Apply directly at www.plan.com/careers

Notes
Are you an experienced and dynamic leader looking to make a real impact in primary care? Peel Group Practice is seeking a highly motivated Practice Manager to lead our dedicated team and help drive the future of our well-established and forward-thinking GP practice.
About Us:
Peel Group Practice is a friendly, patient-focused NHS GP surgery providing high-quality care to our local community. With a strong commitment to clinical excellence, staff wellbeing, and continuous improvement, we pride ourselves on being a supportive and innovative place to work.
We are a three partner practice serving 9250 patients, with a skilled multidisciplinary team including GPs, Nurses,  HCAs, Pharmacy Technician, and administrative staff. We work closely with our Manx Care and wider health system partners to deliver outstanding care.
Role Summary:
As Practice Manager, you will lead the operational management of the Practice and ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. You’ll be responsible for strategic planning, HR, finance, patient services, compliance, and implementing changes in line with Manx Care policy and local needs.
Key responsibilities:
Provide strategic leadership and effective management across all areas of the Practice.
Oversee HR and staffing, including recruitment, training, and performance management – with the assistance of the practice support officer.
Manage Practice finances, budgets, and reporting.
Ensure compliance with local CQC, Health & Safety, GDPR, and other regulatory frameworks.
Optimise use of clinical systems and digital tools.
Drive continuous improvement in service delivery, patient experience, and staff wellbeing.
Opportunity to work in a progressive, stable, and well-organised environment.
What We’re Looking For:
Proven leadership and management experience (ideally in Primary Care or healthcare).
Strong business and financial acumen.
Excellent interpersonal and organisational skills.
Working knowledge of NHS structures and policies (desirable).
A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving and innovation.
We Offer:
Competitive salary (negotiable).
Pension.
Death in service. 
Annual leave and sick pay.
Supportive, forward-thinking team.
A DBS check will be required – paid for by the Practice.
How to Apply:
Please submit your CV and a covering letter outlining your suitability for the role to:
peelmgt@gov.im or Peel Group Practice, Management Team, Albany Road, Peel, IM5 1HU.
For informal enquiries, contact 693890 Closing date: 5th June 2026.

Our client seeks a Management Accountant to join their Finance Team. Role Profile: You In this role, you'll play a key part in supporting the financial health and strategic direction of the Group. You'll contribute to the delivery of accurate, insightful financial reporting and analysis, helping to inform decision-making and drive performance across the Group. Joining the bank and its mission to provide financial excellence by monitoring performance, managing costs, assessing risks, and delivering strategic insights that drive informed decision-making. Key Skills and Experience: A recognised accountant qualification, be part-qualified, or have relevant industry experience. Knowledge of IFRS, UK Accounting Standards, and ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero). Working knowledge of relational database theory sufficient to perform database queries. Excellent Excel and numeracy skills. Strong organisation and communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. All applications will be treated with the utmost discretion.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16434

Job Description
To lead the Credit Risk function for the Business and Commercial Banking business unit (BU) in country, ensuring effective credit risk management across the entire credit lifecycle. To implement the BU's credit strategy in alignment with country-level credit objectives, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements, while supporting sustainable business growth and maintaining a high-quality credit portfolio.

Qualifications:
First Degree in Business Commerce, Finance and Accounting, Generic Management or Risk Management.
Postgraduate in Degree in Business Commerce, Finance and Accounting, Generic Management or Risk Management (Advantageous).

Experience:
This role requires a seasoned leader and expert in Risk management with extensive knowledge of the entire credit lifecycle, together with comprehensive experience within Real Estate Finance and the property sector, including but not limited to, structuring, assessing and managing credit exposures related to property transactions and development projects.
Proven ability to manage stressed and distressed clients, with a track record of implementing effective risk mitigation strategies, negotiating restructuring solutions, and safeguarding the bank’s interests, while maintaining client relationships.
Minimum 5 years People Leadership experience at a Senior organisational level, with a focus on talent management, resourcing, development and retention.
Regulatory environment savvy, a proven track record in large scale and high-level leadership and proactively develop and manage relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and external legal counsel, relevant to the business strategy. Ability to build and develop relationships across the bank with various stakeholders, with the intention of breaking down silos to maximise business growth.
8-10 years’ Experience in managing credit origination (both intuitive and automated) and credit operations, with an ability to handle all aspects of client engagement, including coordinating and execution of transactions.

Behavioural Competencies:
Developing Expertise.   
Challenging Ideas.         
Convincing People. 
Developing Strategies.
Directing People.
Building Relationships.

Technical Competencies:
Economic Capital Management.           
Evaluating Risk Management Effectiveness.     
Risk Acceptance, Awareness, Identification and Management.      
Debt Capacity modelling proficiency.
PD/LGD/EAD understanding and application.
Collateral valuation, legal perfection and Security package design.
Intercreditor & priority structures.
Covenant architecture.
Counterparty credibility assessment, including Pre-sale, Lease & tenant analysis.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop the overall promotional strategy across Sportsbook and Gaming products, aligned with business KPIs and customer behaviour.
Own the promotional calendars, ensuring coverage of key sporting events, gaming seasonality, and commercial objectives.
Identify opportunities to introduce new, compelling promotional formats and offers that differentiate our brands in their respective markets.
Design and manage a wide range of promotional mechanics such as Bet & Gets, Deposit Offers, Cashback, Missions, Tournaments, Price Boosts, cross-product offers.
Work with Product and Tech teams to improve promotional tools, automation, and customer experience.
Oversee end-to-end campaign delivery: briefing, setup, QA, launch, monitoring, and post-campaign review.
Monitor campaign performance and make real-time optimisations based on data, trading impact, and customer response.
Ensure promotions are commercially efficient, clearly communicated, and fully compliant with responsible gambling and regulatory standards.
Track key metrics including participation, incremental revenue, retention uplift, and bonus efficiency.
Partner with BI and Data teams to analyse promotional results and identify actionable insights.
Produce clear, practical reporting to inform future campaign planning and improvements.
Work closely with Sportsbook, Casino, CRM, Trading, Product, Compliance, and Customer Support teams to ensure smooth execution.
Support CRM and Lifecycle teams to integrate promotions into customer journeys and segmentation strategies.
Collaborate with Trading to balance customer appeal with sustainable risk management.
Team Contribution:

Are you a skilled Vehicle Technician looking to take the next step in your career? We are Nissan's authorised service & repair workshop on the Isle of Man, and we are looking for a talented, motivated, and customer-focused individual to join our dynamic workshop team in Ballasalla.
This is a fantastic opportunity to work with one of the world's leading automotive brands, utilising the latest diagnostic equipment and manufacturer training. Whether you are working on routine servicing or complex diagnostics and repairs, you will play a vital role in keeping our customers safely on the road.

In this role, you will be responsible for carrying out servicing, maintenance, and repairs on Nissan vehicles to the highest manufacturer standards. A core part of the position involves performing diagnostic work using Nissan's specialist CONSULT diagnostic equipment, completing warranty repairs, and supporting technical service campaigns. You will conduct thorough vehicle health checks and communicate your findings clearly to our service advisors, while proactively identifying any faults or emerging issues during inspection. You will also be expected to maintain a clean, safe, and well-organised workshop environment at all times, complete job cards and workshop documentation accurately, and keep your technical knowledge current through Nissan's ongoing manufacturer training programmes.

We are seeking a candidate who holds a recognised automotive qualification such as NVQ Level 2 or 3, City & Guilds, or an equivalent accreditation, along with proven hands-on experience as a Vehicle Technician in either a franchised or independent workshop setting. You should have solid experience working with modern vehicle diagnostic systems, and whilst Nissan or other manufacturer-brand training is desirable, it is by no means essential as full training will be provided. Above all, we are looking for someone who takes pride in the quality of their work, communicates well with colleagues and customers alike, holds a full valid Isle of Man driving licence, and has the drive and initiative to perform equally well working independently or as part of a close-knit team.

To apply for this position, please send your CV and a covering letter to: gm@athol.co.im

Our client seeks a Financial Crime Team Leader to join their team. Role Profile: To lead a team of analysts to ensure the team is operating effectively and efficiently in order to reduce the risk of organisations' products & services being used for money laundering & terrorist related activities. Provide assurance to relevant stakeholders that the bank is adhering to all relevant legislation & regulations therefore mitigating the potential for operational losses, fines, penalties or reputational damage to the organisation. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with the Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) to address large scale or sensitive financial crimes, as they relate to specific requests issued by the FIC. Conduct integrated statistical analysis and data analytics based on the reports and outputs generated by the team and generate monthly team reports which indicate performance, challenges and productivity. Continuously maintain an understanding of policies, processes, procedures & systems and review said with the view to find better ways to execute tasks, improve systems, improve training material, improve MLS performance and to influence Group Standards. Coordinate the team in the periodic and ad-hoc system, process or data related reviews (e.g. rule tuning, systems verification, transaction monitoring, bank data testing, quality assurance reviews) as per the respective plans. Deliver holistically on all the regulatory and internal reporting requirements. Oversee the compilation of reports covering findings, conclusions, recommendations and to inform next steps. Oversee the preparation of statistics, dashboards and information for both internal stakeholders and Regulators. Submit reports and Management Information to the line manager for use by the relevant steering committee. Key Skills and Experience: Diploma in Risk Management (Required). First Degree in Risk Management (Preferred). 3 - 4 years; experience in Compliance. Bank processes, products and systems. Different stakeholders at different levels, internal and external. MS Office, Teams and other collaboration tools. The realm of Anti-Fraud, Bribery, Market Abuse, Money Laundering and Combatting Financing of Terrorism Surveillance, Analytics and Investigation.

Confident communicator able to influence senior stakeholders and support operational teams. Proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Onchan District Commissioners are seeking a motivated and customer focussed Library Assistant to support the day-to-day running of our busy and welcoming public library.  This is a varied and rewarding role, providing a high-quality essential service to the community and supporting the Head librarian in delivering a high-quality library experience.  This is an opportunity to play a key role in a valued community service, helping people access information, develop skills and most importantly, enjoy reading.  In this role you will take responsibility for opening, running and closing the library in the absence of the Head Librarian.  You will provide a proactive and friendly service to all customers ensuring the library remains an accessible, organised and engaging space for the community.  We are looking for someone who is committed to providing excellent customer service, has good verbal communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with all sections of the community.   Applicants should have a keen interest in books, public access to information and supporting local communities. Candidates should possess a minimum of five GSCEs Grade C or above including English and Mathematics (or equivalent), be computer literate and competent in using Microsoft Office programmes, or similar packages with the ability to adapt to new systems.  Excellent written communication skills are required along with a conscientious and methodical approach to work.  Further information about the services offered can be found on the Library Website: www.onchan.org.im/library.        A copy of the job description and details about how to apply can be found at: https://jobs.exceedoutsourcing.co.uk/jobs/Onchan-District-Commissioners/20081000008703002/Library-Assistant?source=CareerSite

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Legal Secretary to join our Legal team based in the Isle of Man. This is a key support role, responsible for providing a high standard of administrative and secretarial assistance to the in-house legal function. The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a similar position and a professional, discreet approach to their work.

Please apply via this link- https://careers.dandara.com/job/871819

What you will do:

Producing and formatting legal documentation, letters and contracts.
Managing diaries, organising meetings, and coordinating travel where required.
Handling incoming and outgoing correspondence, including confidential materials.
Maintaining organised electronic and paper filing systems.
Supporting legal and regulatory filings and general document control processes.
Liaising with external solicitors, government bodies and internal departments.
Carrying out general administrative tasks including photocopying, scanning and filing.
What you will have:

Previous experience as a legal secretary or in a similar support role.
Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and Outlook.
Able to handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
Strong communication skills and a calm, methodical approach to work.
Why join Dandara?
Since 1988, Dandara has been designing and building award-winning homes and commercial properties. With over 12,000 properties delivered across the UK and Isle of Man, and more than 100 industry awards, we’re proud of our commitment to quality, value and service.

What we will offer you:

Competitive salary depending on experience.
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 extra days.
Discretionary annual bonus scheme.
Private medical insurance.
Life assurance (3x salary, with option to increase to 4x).
Employee assistance programme.
Discounts on a range of retailers, restaurants, leisure providers and more.
If you are organised, dependable, and looking for a long-term role in a stable and supportive team, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Please apply here - https://careers.dandara.com/job/871819

Key Skills & Experience: 5 GCSE's at Grade C or above or equivalent (including English Language). Strong financial or administrative experience with proven attention to detail. Proficiency in MS Excel and experience with financial documentation. Excellent record-keeping and organisational abilities. Understanding of Financial Regulations or ability to learn quickly. Ready to launch your career in the fascinating world of risk management and insurance? This is your chance to join an established global advisory organisation that operates within the risk management and insurance sector. With a team of over 550 specialists operating across 48 domiciles globally, this organisation provides sophisticated risk management solutions to multinational clients. As a leading captive and insurance management service provider, they are renowned for their innovative approach to complex risk financing and their commitment to delivering exceptional client outcomes. The culture emphasises professional development, collaboration, and making a meaningful impact for clients from the very start of one's career. This Graduate Programme offers an exceptional opportunity to work with real clients from day one while building practical skills in captive insurance management. You'll rotate across three core business areas - Finance, Underwriting, and Governance - gaining comprehensive exposure to management accounting, insurance operations, and regulatory compliance work. What makes this role special: Structured rotational programme across Finance, Underwriting, and Governance. Direct client exposure including attendance at Board meetings. Professional qualification support through the Chartered Insurance Institute. Paid study leave and comprehensive learning materials. Dedicated mentorship and ongoing development support. We're looking for graduates with: 2:1 degree (any subject) and genuine interest in insurance and risk. Strong numerical and analytical skills with commercial mindset. Excellent communication abilities and team collaboration skills. Curiosity about how insurance fits into the wider business environment. Proficiency in Excel, Word, and Outlook (work experience beneficial but not required). Applications are processed on a rolling basis, so early application is recommended.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16417

Notes
Altenar is a leading IT company founded in 2011 and headquartered in the Isle of Man, with offices in Malta, Greece, Georgia, Brazil and Uruguay.
We are seeking a proactive and detail oriented Junior Legal/Contracts Officer to support the legal, contracts, and governance functions of the business.
Key Responsibilities:
Assisting with the corporate governance of the Altenar group of Companies, including arranging board meetings and preparing agendas and board packs.
Assisting with the creation and preparation of documents for presentation to the Board of Directors for review and signature, particularly customer onboarding documentation.
Attending board meetings to assist with the recording and preparation of accurate board minutes.
Working with the Contracts Manager to ensure legal documents progress efficiently from drafting and collaboration (with all relevant stakeholders) through negotiation to  execution.
Ensuring physical and electronic filing is completed promptly and accurately, including  maintaining internal document databases and records.
Assisting the Compliance department with customer and supplier on-boarding processes.
Supporting general company administration, including insurance and data protection renewals and other corporate administrative requirements as they  arise. 
Assisting with banking administration and payment processes, as required.
Providing general administrative and ad-hoc business support as required from time to time.

Essential Requirements:
Good standard of general education, including GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths.
Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities.
Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
Proactive and self motivated approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
Willingness and aptitude to learn new processes, systems, and areas of the business.
Ability to follow instruction carefully while also using initiative and sound judgement

Desirable Requirements:
Previous experience in an administrative, governance, legal support, compliance or company secretarial role, including exposure to board meetings or governance processes
Experience working within a regulated industry or professional services environment.
Familiarity with legal documentation, contracts administration, or compliance processes.
Experience maintaining document management systems or internal databases.
Understanding of customer and supplier onboarding processes.
Knowledge of data protection requirements and general corporate administration.

For more details and to apply contact job@altenar.com

IFGL is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Due Diligence Specialist & Legal Support professional to join our Risk, Legal & Compliance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in corporate due diligence, legal administration, or company secretarial support who is looking to develop their career within a professional financial services environment.

Reporting to the Data Protection Officer & Legal Specialist, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date corporate due diligence records for IFGL legal entities. You will work closely with relationship owners across the business to manage and review third-party due diligence requests and ensure appropriate documentation is supplied consistently and accurately.

You will also provide broader legal and governance support, including assistance with board resolutions, governance committee administration, and minute taking.

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Maintain current and accurate records of corporate due diligence documentation. 
Review, approve, and record non-standard due diligence responses. 
Respond to internal and external due diligence queries in a timely manner. 
Conduct regular reviews of due diligence records to ensure accuracy and compliance. 
Support internal stakeholders with guidance on due diligence requirements and documentation standards. 
Assist the wider Group Legal Team with data protection and corporate governance activities. 
Prepare board resolutions and provide minute-taking support for governance committees. 

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
Good understanding of corporate legal structures. 
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work accurately under pressure. 
Strong organisational and planning skills. 
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Ideally has minimum of two years’ experience within a company secretarial, legal support, or financial services environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
If you are interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com   
We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in corporate due diligence, legal administration, or company secretarial support who is looking to develop their career within a professional financial services environment.

Reporting to the Data Protection Officer & Legal Specialist, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date corporate due diligence records for IFGL legal entities. You will work closely with relationship owners across the business to manage and review third-party due diligence requests and ensure appropriate documentation is supplied consistently and accurately.

You will also provide broader legal and governance support, including assistance with board resolutions, governance committee administration, and minute taking.

The main duties for the role holder will include:
Maintain current and accurate records of corporate due diligence documentation. 
Review, approve, and record non-standard due diligence responses. 
Respond to internal and external due diligence queries in a timely manner. 
Conduct regular reviews of due diligence records to ensure accuracy and compliance. 
Support internal stakeholders with guidance on due diligence requirements and documentation standards. 
Assist the wider Group Legal Team with data protection and corporate governance activities. 
Prepare board resolutions and provide minute-taking support for governance committees. 

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidates will need to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
Good understanding of corporate legal structures. 
Excellent attention to detail and ability to work accurately under pressure. 
Strong organisational and planning skills. 
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Ideally has minimum of two years’ experience within a company secretarial, legal support, or financial services environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
If you are interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com   
We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.
The closing date for this vacancy will be 5 June 2026.

Our client seeks an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join their team. You will play a crucial role in defining and maintaining Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting Financing of Terror (AML/CFT) Quality Assurance frameworks. This is your opportunity to work alongside motivated professionals, while contributing to meaningful regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Key Responsibilities: Define and maintain the AML/CFT Quality Assurance framework in line with relevant regulations and industry best practices. Conduct comprehensive QA reviews across Money Laundering Surveillance (MLS) processes in accordance with established frameworks. Perform in-depth analysis to ensure organisational products and services adhere to all relevant legislation and regulations. Capture findings and conclusions in required reporting formats and prepare outcomes as prescribed by policies and procedures. Collaborate with the Financial Intelligence Centre to address large scale or sensitive financial crimes as required. Contribute to periodic and ad-hoc system, process or data related reviews including rule tuning and transaction monitoring. Manage and monitor implementation of improvements and remedial actions from QA findings until completion. Key Skills & Experience: Diploma in Risk Management. 3-4 years' experience in Compliance with specific focus on AML/CFT processes. Proven experience in analysis of money laundering and terrorist financing indicators and trends. Strong background in banking processes, products and systems. Experience in quality assurance or audit with demonstrated ability to conduct qualitative assessments. Experience in oversight roles related to AML/CFT analytics. Background in Anti-Fraud, Anti-Bribery, Anti-Market Abuse, Anti-Money Laundering and CFT Surveillance. Strong stakeholder management skills across various internal and external levels.

Providing an outstanding guest experience sits at the very heart of Island Escapes, and this role demands someone who takes genuine ownership of that responsibility. The Property Management Co-ordinator is pivotal to ensuring the business operates seamlessly day to day, maintaining and improving systems, responding decisively to issues, and ensuring every property meets the high standards our guests expect. This is a fast-paced, hands-on position where problems don’t wait, and neither can you; success in this role requires a highly resilient, resourceful individual who remains calm under pressure, adapts quickly, and follows challenges through to resolution.

Based in our Castletown office, this is a 35-hour-per-week role with flexible working options. However, during our peak season (April to October), you will work to an agreed rota including up to two Saturdays per month (with time off in lieu during the week). This is not purely office-based with regular travel across the island to visit and assess properties which is essential, so a full driving licence is required.

We operate an out-of-hours on-call service for our guests, and you will take your share of responsibility on a rota basis (up to two evenings per week and one weekend per month). While many issues can be resolved remotely, there will be occasions where you must attend properties in person, often at short notice. This aspect of the role further underscores the need for someone dependable, proactive, and resilient, who can think clearly and act confidently in unexpected situations.

Island Escapes is a technology-driven business, so strong IT skills and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems are essential.

As a growing company, we offer genuine opportunities for career progression for the right individual—particularly someone who demonstrates initiative, reliability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.

In addition, you will support our sister company, Homestay IOM Ltd, throughout the year—most notably assisting with the TT Homestay scheme delivered on behalf of the Isle of Man Government. This will involve coordinating with homeowners, visitors, and external partners to ensure a smooth and professional experience for all involved.

Director of Isle of Man Services & Quality, Performance and Safeguarding.
Service: Isle of Man Services & Quality, Performance and Safeguarding.

Salary: £85,000 - £95,000 FTE per annum* Additionally £480 FTE per annum home-based working allowance.

Location: Homebased with a requirement to be present on the Isle of Man for at least three days/30 hours a week, including regular travel to our London Head Office.

Contract & Hours: Permanent, 37 hours per week. We offer flexible working arrangements.

Family Action & the Role’s Impact:
Family Action supports people through change, challenge or crisis. It’s what we’ve done for over 150 years. We protect children, support young people and adults and offer direct, practical help to families and communities. We see first-hand the power of family to shape lives, for better or worse, so we speak up for the importance of family in national and local policymaking, amplify family voices and represent the changing needs of families in the UK today.

Are you an innovative, inspirational leader, who is solution focused and passionate about making a difference? Do you have the energy and focus to lead an extraordinary combination of services for children and families across the Isle of Man and take organisational responsibility for quality, performance and safeguarding?

Do you have a proven track record of delivering safe, excellent, inclusive services and cultivating quality and diversity? Are you hungry to show how you can drive system change? Are you looking for a diverse, ambitious and fast paced organisation where you can be part of the Executive leadership team – if so, you have found it.

About the Role:
The Director’s primary function is to provide strategic, operational and professional leadership across Family Action’s services on the Isle of Man (children’s residential homes, secure accommodation, short-stay homes, wraparound and edge of care services, semi independent accommodation, aftercare services, family support and Family Time) - ensuring consistently high-quality, safe, trauma informed practice and provision that meets statutory requirements and best practice standards.

The Director will be the organisational lead for quality assurance, performance and safeguarding, responsible for designing, implementing and assuring robust governance, oversight, and continuous improvement frameworks. They will collaborate closely with Manx Care, Commissioners, partners, multi agency safeguarding arrangements, and internal teams to deliver exceptional outcomes for looked after children, care leavers and families - modelling the organisation’s values; people focus, can do, excellence and mutual respect.

Full advert: https://careers.family-action.org.uk/FamilyAction/JobDescription/itYGJGQtpbk?&mId=YRG1ZpImAQY

You’ll lead our Family Support and Supervised Contact services in an organisation known for its positive culture, flexible working and flat structure – where people are encouraged to think differently, test new ideas and speak up.

Leading and developing two services to deliver safe, effective and compassionate support to children and families.
Creating a team culture where staff feel confident, supported and empowered.
Supporting innovation and continuous improvement, helping new ideas to flourish into practice. 
Working collaboratively with commissioners, partners and senior colleagues.
Ensuring strong governance, safeguarding, quality assurance and performance oversight.
Balancing operational delivery with strategic thinking and service development.

A leadership style that is relational, inclusive and strengths?based.

Curiosity, creativity and the courage to think beyond ‘how things have always been done’.

Notes
Our client, a long established fiduciary services business, is seeking a senior individual to take responsibility for its client administration function. The role sits at senior level within the organisation and combines operational oversight, team coordination and direct involvement in complex fiduciary client matters. The focus is on maintaining high service standards, ensuring regulatory obligations are met and supporting the effective running of the function. Key Responsibilities: Oversee day-to-day fiduciary administration activity, ensuring workloads are prioritised and deadlines consistently achieved. Take responsibility for a small portfolio of trust and company structures, including more complex or sensitive arrangements. Act as escalation point for technical fiduciary matters requiring experience and sound judgement. Maintain oversight of client review cycles, periodic compliance activity and associated deadlines. Monitor debtor balances and broader operational risk indicators, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution. Review and interpret management information relating to workload, performance and client activity. Support senior stakeholders with operational planning and client-related matters as required. Contribute to the refinement of internal processes, controls and procedural consistency. Provide day-to-day structure across a small administration team, supporting clarity of expectations and delivery standards. Assist with development of team capability through feedback, guidance and on the job support. Maintain effective working relationships with clients, intermediaries and other stakeholders. Key Skills and Experience: Significant experience in fiduciary administration within trust and company services. Strong technical understanding of trust and corporate structures and relevant regulatory frameworks. Previous experience in a supervisory, senior leadership position. Comfortable managing complex fiduciary matters and working under regulatory scrutiny. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a structured way. Clear, practical communicator with a professional and commercially aware approach. Additional Requirements: STEP, CGI/ICSA or equivalent professional qualification would be beneficial but is not essential. Solid experience working within Isle of Man fiduciary regulatory and governance environments. Confident user of standard administration and reporting systems. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16520

Our client seeks an experienced Business Analyst to join their Change Department for a 6-month contract. The successful candidate will define business requirements, ways of working and governance needed to ensure Microsoft 365 (including Copilot and SharePoint Online) deliver measurable value across the Company. Key Responsibilities: Define standardised business requirements and ways of working across Microsoft 365 applications, including (but not limited to): Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Loop, Forms, Bookings, Project, Viva Engage. Work with business champions to define business-led requirements for information ownership and accountability (with a strong focus on SharePoint Online) as well as community and collaboration ownership models. Define business-led requirements for data quality and information structure, feeding into project requirements. Identify business and organisational requirements needed to safely enable Copilot. Provide clear, structured inputs into governance and policy design for M365 applications. Define measurable benefits, outcomes, and success criteria for M365 and Copilot adoption. Work closely with 3rd party suppliers to drive timely delivery. Contribute to training content and collaborate closely with the M365 Trainer. Manage and build the project backlog, ensuring clear and actionable requirements. Provide BA input into: Scope definition (in/out), risks, assumptions, and dependencies and options analysis for M365 enablement. Key Skills & Experience: Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital transformation or enterprise tooling programmes. Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 applications and their business use cases. Experience in defining business processes, governance, operating models and requirements. Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, including working with business champions and senior leaders. Ability to translate business needs into structured, clear documentation and backlogs. Strong understanding of information management concepts (ownership, structure, data quality). Experience working with suppliers and internal delivery teams in a project environment. Ideally have exposure to Microsoft Copilot or similar AI?enabled business tools.Experience with Azure Cloud or DevOps would be desirable.

Due to continued expansion, our client is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to join their Isle of Man operations. Profile: This role is responsible for managing contract documentation by leading the onboarding process. Including the preparation, coordination and maintenance of contractual agreements, preparation of minutes and resolutions to ensure that statutory records are in place, whilst ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal procedures. Key Responsibilities: Prepare, review, and manage contracts, agreements, and related documentation ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies and legal requirements. Act as lead for onboarding of B2B gaming clients: coordinating with departments (sales, compliance, and finance) to collect relevant information and ensure contractual obligations are met. Preparation of minutes and resolutions for proper documentation of executed contracts and agreements. Maintaining contract database and tracking systems to ensure up-to-date and accurate records. Support contract negotiation processes by preparing drafts, gathering input, and facilitating review cycles. Monitor contract deadlines, renewal dates, and compliance milestones, proactively alert stakeholders of upcoming actions. Assist in resolving contract-related disputes or issues, escalating complex matters as appropriate. Ensure processes and procedures are followed consistently and recommend improvements for greater efficiency. Key Skills and Experience: The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of a contract lifecycle, management and legal terminology. Direct experience in a legal support or contracts administration role. Experience with B2B onboarding and due diligence.Comfortable around complex and multi-jurisdictional corporate structures. Experience in company secretarial and statutory administration. Proficiency with contract management software, Microsoft Office Suite, and document management systems (desired). Strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise effectively with others. Takes full responsibility for own deliverables and deadlines, independently planning, prioritising and executing work to ensure timely and high-quality outcomes. Excellent organisational skills and high attention to detail.Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines. Strong team orientation (including the ability to work well with remote team members). Good problem-solving skills.

Key Skills & Experience: Previous experience within a settlements or similar operational environment. Strong knowledge of unit trusts and equity markets. Strong written and verbal communication skills. High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Ability to manage workload effectively and meet deadlines. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate across multiple teams.

Head of Compliance – AstroPay Global (IOM) Limited.
The role in a nutshell: Senior compliance leader for the Isle of Man entity, holding the R13 Controlled Function. Reports directly to the Board and Group CCO, operating with significant independence.

What matters most:
Core responsibilities:

R13 Controlled Function holder before the local regulator (IOMFSA).
Own the full compliance framework under the Class 8 licence (payments/e-money).
Supervise the MLRO and lead the IOM compliance team.
Primary point of contact with the IOMFSA.
Build and maintain policies, procedures, and the Compliance Monitoring Program.
Board-level reporting and regulatory submissions.

Required profile:

5+ years in financial services compliance, in a senior role.
Deep knowledge of Isle of Man regulatory framework (FSA 2008, Rule Book 2016, AML/CFT).
Hands-on experience dealing directly with regulators.
Relevant professional qualification (e.g. ICA Diploma).
FinTech, payments, or e-money background highly desirable.

First 6 months focus:

Audit the existing compliance framework, identify gaps, and build an improvement roadmap.
Establish strong relationships with IOMFSA, the Board, and key internal stakeholders.

Nice to haves:

Multi-jurisdiction compliance experience.
Compliance tech / data analytics exposure.
Spanish language skills.

To apply for the role click this link: https://astropay.careers.hibob.com/jobs?department=265704199

Responsibilities include maintaining up-to-date lists of current crew and statutory certificates for the yachts, liaising with clients and crew to facilitate the renewal of necessary certifications, and assisting the Crewing and Recruitment Departments with crew-related queries. As an Assistant Manager you will support your Store Leader to deliver excellent customer care and operational standards every day by connecting with customers to gain a deep understanding of their needs. 
Working across both retail and pharmacy, you will lead and inspire your team by demonstrating your leadership skills on the shop floor, showcasing how to provide brilliant service and care.

Key responsibilities include leading your team to deliver business growth by providing excellent care to customers and patients, while taking responsibility for the performance and development of your team through regular coaching and reviews. You will deliver a sustainable and efficient retail and pharmacy business by ensuring stock availability, controlling costs, minimising loss, and meeting customer expectations. The role also involves conducting regular reviews, audits, and risk assessments to protect patient and public safety, as well as interpreting data, trends, and insights to respond quickly to the changing needs of customers.

To succeed in this role, you will need experience leading a team within a customer-facing environment, an understanding of how to achieve performance goals through inspiring and coaching others, and a collaborative personality that thrives in a team-centred setting. It would also be beneficial to have experience working within community pharmacy and confidence in navigating and embracing new technology.

About Us:

We are one of the Isle of Man’s leading automotive dealerships delivering an outstanding ownership experience to our customers across the island. Our team is built on trust, professionalism, and a genuine passion for all things automotive, and we are now looking to expand that team with the addition of a talented and driven Car Salesperson.

The Role:

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious individual to join our busy sales floor and become a key part of our customer-facing team. As a Car Salesperson, you will be responsible for guiding customers through every stage of their vehicle purchase, from the initial enquiry and showroom visit right through to handover and beyond. You will develop lasting relationships with both new and returning customers, ensuring that every interaction reflects the high standards our dealership is known for.
Day to day, you will be meeting and greeting customers, understanding their needs, presenting and demonstrating the vehicles, preparing finance proposals, and negotiating sales in a professional and transparent manner. You will also be expected to manage your own customer pipeline, follow up on leads, and work towards individual and team sales targets. Full product training will be provided, so while knowledge of vehicles is an advantage, it is certainly not essential.

What We’re Looking For:

We are looking for someone with a natural flair for sales and a genuine enthusiasm for engaging with people. Previous experience in automotive retail is desirable, but we welcome applications from candidates who have a strong background in any customer-facing or target-driven sales environment. What matters most to us is attitude, energy, and a commitment to delivering an exceptional experience every time.
You will need to be an excellent communicator who can build rapport quickly, listen carefully to what customers want, and present solutions with confidence and clarity. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage your time effectively are also important, as is a proactive approach to generating and following up on sales opportunities. A full, clean driving licence is essential for this role.

What We Offer:

In return for your hard work and dedication, we offer a competitive basic salary alongside an attractive commission structure that rewards your results. You will receive ongoing training, giving you industry-recognised qualifications and keeping your product knowledge sharp. We provide a supportive and friendly working environment where your development is taken seriously.

This is a fantastic chance to build a rewarding long-term career with an established and respected dealership, in a role where your effort genuinely makes a difference. The Isle of Man is a great place to live and work, and we are proud to be part of its community.

How to Apply:

If you have the drive and personality to excel in this role, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a brief covering letter to gm@athol.co.im

Notes
The postholder will contribute to existing research and survey programmes focussed on the extensive network of Manx Marine Nature Reserves (https://www.gov.im/MNR). This network includes Port Erin Bay MNR which has been closed to mobile gear fishing since 1989 and Ramsey Bay MNR which features a designated Fisheries Management Zone. A primary focus of the role will be to support the establishment of a continuous marine benthic monitoring programme, both inside the MNRs and in the wider territorial sea as required, employing a range of methods which may include video mapping and benthic sampling. The post-holder will contribute to the generation of georeferenced habitat maps and species distribution data as well as investigating the distribution and ecology of key habitats including seagrass, maerl, Modiolus reefs and offshore mud.
